app room-maintenance (/apps/room-maintenance)
  class internal-tool
  owner group:hotel-ops-leads
  audience group:hotel-staff
  page /tickets  require staff
  page /tickets/report  require staff
  page /tickets/{id}  require staff  guard
  page /tickets/{id}/edit  require staff  guard
  page /tickets/{id}/status  require staff, hotel-ops  guard
  database
  size S
  resources small
  ttl 180d
  writes INSERT rooms, INSERT tickets, UPDATE tickets
  surface 5 (5 entry points, 3 effects)
  local note: dev.yaml names no workspace at or above this folder, so aicoded dev runs the apps here with its defaults: no local MySQL server, no local values, and the personas all-roles and no-roles; howto E-DEV-002 shows the format of dev.yaml
  local mysql not set
